hero.title: I build and defend systems that don't fail quietly.
hero.valueProposition: Cybersecurity researcher and incoming Erasmus Mundus Scholar with hands-on experience in network administration, system deployment, and threat discovery. I run critical IT infrastructure and software rollouts under high-pressure conditions and focus on Zero Trust, Cloud Security, and SASE.

philosophy.title: Philosophy & Approach
content: In the domain of critical infrastructure and high-stakes operations, failure is not simply an inconvenience—it is often a catastrophic event. My approach to cybersecurity and system administration is rooted in the belief that resilience must be engineered from the ground up. Whether analyzing memory dumps for forensic anomalies or deploying agentic AI systems for predictive maintenance, I prioritize robust, deterministic architectures over superficial complexity.

My background as a Search & Rescue Operator has profoundly shaped my engineering methodology. Operating under life-critical pressure instills a rigorous discipline: systems must be intuitive, redundancies must be automatic, and fail-safes must be absolute. I carry this philosophy into my technical work, ensuring that every deployment, from Kubernetes clusters to Zero Trust network configurations, is designed to withstand both adversarial actions and environmental degradation.

items.title: Anomaly Detection in Electric Distribution Systems
items.summary: Collaborative research with BEDAS focusing on utilizing advanced time-series analysis and machine learning to identify anomalous behavior within critical power distribution networks.

items.title: Brain-Computer Interface Architecture Overview
items.executiveSummary: This presentation covers the architecture of EEG-driven BCI systems, detailing the signal processing pipeline and the machine learning models used for real-time inference in clinical settings.

timeline.description: Awarded full EU scholarship based on academic excellence. Focus on Applied Cybersecurity, Cryptography, and Network Security across multiple European institutions.
Conducting research on Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems, alongside delivering laboratory sessions for MIS undergraduates on algorithm design.
Administered network and systems infrastructure for the Center on Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection. Supported GPU-accelerated ML projects.

Conduct high-stakes urban and mountain search & rescue operations under life-critical pressure. Managing real-world life-or-death crises on the ground translates to absolute composure when resolving critical server outages or security breaches in the digital realm.
